final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.customer_id AS c1, c.gender AS c2, COUNT(*) AS c3 FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.gender), s2 AS (SELECT c2 AS g, SUM(c3) AS tot FROM s1 GROUP BY c2), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c3 AS c3, CAST(s1.c3 AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.tot, 0) AS c4 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON CAST(s1.c2 AS TEXT) = CAST(s2.g AS TEXT)), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c4) AS a FROM s3) SELECT s3.c1, s3.c2, s3.c3, s3.c4, s3.c4 - s4.a AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c4 > s4.a ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
